purpose: Canonical apps_* end-to-end certification requirement universe. SSOT consumed by scripts/compile_apps_e2e_signoff.py (W3). Sibling to certification/requirements_source.json (apps_rg Fort Knox).

requirements.title: Compiler positive-control canary (catalog self-consistency)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Compiler emits ACCEPTED only when the catalog parses, every req_id is unique, every depends_on_req_ids target exists, and this row's is_positive_control flag is the ONLY true. Flipping any of those makes the compiler FAIL on this row, proving compiler plumbing is alive.
requirements.notes: Mirrors apps_rg's RTC-REQ-001 canary. If compiler is broken, this row cannot pass.

requirements.title: All runtime apps emit an apps_e2e_proof bundle (smoke gate)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Each runtime-required app's harness invocation produces an apps_e2e_proof.json at the expected path with schema_version=apps_e2e_proof/2026-05-01/v1 and non-empty run_id.
requirements.notes: Enforced by Gate 1 (smoke). Paired with APPS-REQ-025..030 for per-app binding.

requirements.title: Bundle schema validity
requirements.acceptance_rule: Every emitted bundle validates against apps_e2e_proof_bundle.schema.json without validator errors.

requirements.title: app_name consistency across AppSpec and bundle payload
requirements.acceptance_rule: bundle.proof_payload.app_name equals the AppSpec.app_name for that bundle. No bundle may claim a different app than the spec declaring it.

requirements.title: entrypoint_command validity
requirements.acceptance_rule: bundle.proof_payload.entrypoint_command is non-empty and matches AppSpec.entrypoint_command exactly.

requirements.title: harness_pass semantics
requirements.acceptance_rule: bundle.harness_pass is true iff bundle.blocking_gaps is empty AND certification_level is SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED (or a permitted waiver level). harness_pass=false MUST carry at least one blocking_gap.

requirements.title: Timestamps are ISO UTC
requirements.acceptance_rule: All bundle timestamp fields (generated_at_utc, harness_started_at_utc, harness_ended_at_utc) parse as RFC 3339 UTC.

requirements.title: ID threading (run_id, request_id, trace_root) across receipts
requirements.acceptance_rule: All Phase-2 receipts carry matching run_id, request_id, and trace_root aligned with the bundle header. Any mismatch surfaces run_id_threading_violation / request_id_threading_violation / trace_root_threading_violation.

requirements.title: Runtime artifact presence (all required receipt refs)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Every ref field declared by required_receipts() for the app's AppSpec points to a file that exists on disk with the declared sha256.

requirements.title: Runtime artifact hash binding
requirements.acceptance_rule: Every runtime_*_ref in the bundle has a matching sha256 in the bundle's artifact manifest AND the on-disk file hashes to that value.

requirements.title: Static DAG proof on disk (managed-workflow apps)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Apps with AppSpec.expects_static_dag=true MUST produce a static_dag_cert_proof.json referenced by bundle.static_dag_ref that exists on disk with a matching sha256.

requirements.title: Static DAG hash binding (L3 receipt ↔ bundle ↔ inline summary)
requirements.acceptance_rule: For managed-workflow apps: L3 runtime receipt's static_dag_hash (or legacy dag_sha256) matches either bundle.static_dag_sha256 or bundle.static_dag_proof_inline_summary.dag_sha256. Both branches are canonical.
requirements.notes: N6 rule. Accepts either hash per 2026-05-02 refinement.

requirements.title: Route contract consistency (no bypass-id mismatch, no duplicate routes)
requirements.acceptance_rule: route_registry.yaml route_id matches bundle.route_contract.route_id. For bypass apps, route_id equals the declared bypass route. No duplicate route_contract entries across bundles.

requirements.title: L6 emission ordering (L6 observed after Exit)
requirements.acceptance_rule: runtime_l6_exhaust_bundle.generated_at_utc >= runtime_exit_receipt.generated_at_utc. L6 MUST NOT be emitted before Exit.

requirements.title: Exit disposition value is from approved set
requirements.acceptance_rule: exit_review_packet.disposition is in {COMPLETED_OK, COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS, FAILED}; no free-form values accepted.

requirements.title: Overlay consistency with success
requirements.acceptance_rule: bundle.overlay.violations MUST be empty when bundle.harness_pass=true AND certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED.

requirements.title: No stale artifacts in run_dir
requirements.acceptance_rule: run_dir contains only receipts/artifacts produced by the current run_id. Artifacts with older run_ids or unreferenced files cause stale_artifacts_in_run_dir.

requirements.title: No synthetic trace in certified bundle (negative control)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Any bundle with runtime_mode in {synthetic, fabricated, trace_synthesized} AND success=true MUST be rejected by verifier_strict with synthetic_trace_in_certified_bundle.

requirements.title: No mock_mode in certified bundle (negative control)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Bundle with runtime_mode=mock AND success=true MUST be rejected by verifier_strict with mock_mode_in_certified_bundle.

requirements.title: No fixture runtime_mode in certified bundle (negative control)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Bundle with runtime_mode=fixture AND certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED MUST be rejected with fixture_runtime_mode_in_certified_bundle.

requirements.title: runtime_mode is in approved_live_modes under strict
requirements.acceptance_rule: For SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, runtime_mode MUST be in the approved_live_modes allowlist (currently: live, live_governed).

requirements.title: certification_level invariant (level ↔ success ↔ blocking_gaps)
requirements.acceptance_rule: SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED requires success=true AND blocking_gaps=[] AND runtime_mode in approved_live_modes. success=true with level weaker than SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED is rejected with success_true_but_level_weaker_than_certified.

requirements.title: artifact_kind schema validity (strict)
requirements.acceptance_rule: Every entry in bundle.artifact_manifest has an artifact_kind from the ArtifactKind enum; no duplicate kinds within a single manifest.

requirements.title: required_receipts present per AppSpec
requirements.acceptance_rule: Every (ref_field, artifact_kind) tuple returned by required_receipts(spec) is present and non-null in the bundle's artifact_manifest.

requirements.title: apps_rg spine certification
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_rg live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict.

requirements.title: apps_exec spine certification
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_exec live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict.

requirements.title: apps_eval spine certification
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_eval live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict.

requirements.title: apps_research spine certification
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_research live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict.

requirements.title: apps_lic spine certification (managed workflow + static DAG)
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_lic live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict, and a valid static-DAG binding (APPS-REQ-011 + APPS-REQ-012).

requirements.title: apps_qna spine certification
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_qna live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict.

requirements.title: apps_underwriting_ai spine certification
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_underwriting_ai live invocation yields apps_e2e_proof.json with certification_level=SPINE_COMPLETE_CERTIFIED, zero blocking_gaps under strict.

requirements.title: apps_e2e_matrix integrity (sha256 + row count)
requirements.acceptance_rule: apps_e2e_matrix.json at the canonical path has schema_version=apps_e2e_matrix/2026-05-01/v1, exactly 8 rows (one per AppSpec), and every row's bundle_sha256 matches the on-disk file.
